training: Frozen DINOv2, new shared 64/48-channel trunk, separate carried box and visible point/density heads. One epoch of all native Roboflow training boxes (including three augmented versions per source stem), batches of 32. Every step draws two reviewed scalar images and two reviewed benchmark fitting frames. No generic dataset images or labels used in the updates.
annotation_contract: Zero carried boxes affect only the carried-objectness loss. All 300 explicit reviewed totals, including those paired with box-empty images, supervise whole-image inventory. Outside a carried box there is no inventory background label. The 42 exhaustive benchmark training labels supervise foreground ROI points, regional mass and inventory totals.
arms_and_loss: Same random initialization, exact input draws, network, compute and AdamW schedule for the four arms. L = target center/offset + target global log count + target 4x4 regional log counts + (0 or .5) carried box loss + (0 or .5) reviewed whole-image log count loss. No normalization mixes frames.
decode: Freeze each mass floor at max(0.5, maximum unrounded mass of three reviewed training empties). Preserve verifier points. When mass exceeds that floor add up to min(64,max(0,round_half_up(mass)-verifier_count)) newly ranked centers, separated by 8px on long side 1024. Equal-budget control uses points-only locations at the joint arm per-frame quota.
decision: Report primary joint-vs-frozen verifier and joint-vs-matched points-only control on count MAE and pooled one-to-one F1@8. Better localization beyond budget requires more matches than the equal-budget point-only ranking. Report all arms, groups, low 1-11, empty FP, RMSE, bias, GAME1/2, and all tradeoffs. No late threshold/arm/seed selection.
scope: Sack-only new training and evaluation. DINOv2 initialization and the historical verifier have public pretrained weights. 23 development and 51 retrospectively reused test frames do not enter fitting, operating-point selection or the GPU worker as labels. All 300 totals are training supervision, including 150 from native Roboflow validation. No native Roboflow test scoring or relabeling.
